description: Hand Aurgus one of your three rebate files (CSV) to read into your tenant: 'pos' (your POS / sell-through extract — what was earned), 'claims' (the claims you submitted), or 'credits' (credit memos / vendor invoices you received). Give it the raw CSV, which kind of file it is, and a note of which of your columns maps to which Aurgus field. Rows with blank or bad amounts are held and reported back to you — never quietly booked as $0 — and nothing touches your numbers until a person certifies the mapping. Requires a connected Aurgus account.

csv.description: The raw CSV content of your extract (header row + data rows).

kind.description: Which file this is: 'pos' (sales/POS extract — earned), 'claims' (claims submitted), or 'credits' (credit memos / vendor invoices received). Defaults to 'pos'.

mapping.description: Map each of your column headers to an Aurgus field. pos fields: source_transaction_id, transaction_at, end_customer_id, material_id, amount_usd, distributor_id, quantity. claims fields: source_claim_id, claim_type, amount_claimed_usd, claim_date, end_customer_id, material_id. credits fields: source_credit_id, amount_credited_usd, credit_date, end_customer_id, material_id. Example: {"Invoice #":"source_transaction_id","Net Sales":"amount_usd"}.

name: ingest
